title: SEMCOG active rain-gauge stations, June 2004
html:
Active stations in June 2004

The map locates SEMCOG rain gauges across five counties in southeastern Michigan: Livingston in the northwest, Oakland to its east, Macomb in the northeast, Washtenaw in the southwest, and Wayne in the southeast. County boundaries are drawn as black lines. Each gauge is labeled with its station code. Crosses mark gauge locations and asterisks identify roof-exposure locations.

Station prefixes visible on the map are A, L, M, O and W. The source does not give coordinates or street addresses; these cannot be recovered exactly from the printed map alone.

limitations: Exact map point positions and the complete set of individual station labels have not been transcribed. The linked 2003 table is related data, not a June 2004 station inventory.
